main.description: A set of links, such as accounts on other sites. Readers never fetch the linked site to find an icon or a name: they use the link's own icon, else their own list of known sites.

layout.description: How readers arrange the links. Absent or unknown means list.

uri.description: An http or https URL. Readers ignore any other scheme.

label.description: Text shown for the link. When present it is shown, even if the URL names an account; when absent, readers show the account or site name.

icon.description: A small square icon for the link, uploaded with it. Readers check and re-encode it, and show it no larger than an icon. Absent: the reader's own icon for a known site, or none.
